A Key Barrier We Will Fix
Most Albertans Think AEF Is Not for Them. It Is.

One of the biggest blockers to membership growth is simple perception. Recreational riders, trail riders, and hobbyists across Alberta assume AEF is only for competitive equestrians. They have no idea the membership includes $5M liability coverage, $40K AD&D insurance, and programs built for beginners, families, and casual riders.

A major part of this campaign is shifting that perception through content, community, and targeted messaging that speaks directly to the people who have been overlooking AEF. Not because they are not interested, but because nobody has told them it is for them too.

Trail riders and hobbyists They ride in Alberta and have never heard of AEF, or they think it is for competitive riders only. We change that with identity-driven messaging and community content.
Families and new riders Parents want safety and structure. They do not know AEF exists. We reach them through Learn to Ride and Rookie Riders messaging with a welcoming, approachable tone.
Recreational adults People who ride for enjoyment, not competition. They are the largest untapped segment. We make AEF feel like a community they belong to, not a governing body they answer to.

To Get Started

1
Analytics and Search Console Access
Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console admin access so we can run a proper audit and set accurate baselines before the campaign starts.
2
Social Media Admin Access
Meta Business Suite admin access for Instagram and Facebook, needed to run ads, schedule content, and track performance across both platforms.
3
Previous Agency Debrief
A brief summary of what did not work with the previous contractor, what was promised and what fell short. Helps us get it right from Day 1.
